leadership.name: Sir Evang. Barisere Chamberline Friday
leadership.title: Executive Director & Founder
leadership.bio: Sir Evang. Barisere Chamberline Friday is the Founder and Chairman of Hope for the Hopeless, Orphans and Entrepreneurial Initiatives. He is a Nigerian humanitarian and social development advocate from Bue-Gbor community of Kpite Tai in Tai Local Government Area of Rivers State, Nigeria. He established the organization in response to the growing challenges faced by vulnerable groups including orphans, widows, underprivileged families, and at-risk youth. His vision is centered on restoring hope, dignity, and opportunity to disadvantaged individuals through structured humanitarian intervention. The organization provides support through the distribution of food items, clothing, and other essential relief materials to vulnerable communities, alongside initiatives aimed at social welfare and youth support. His guiding philosophy is reflected in the organization’s motto: 'Our Name… Our Concern'.

boardMembers.name: Chief Olu Adewale
boardMembers.title: Board Chairman
boardMembers.bio: Chief Olu Adewale is a renowned business leader and philanthropist. His strategic guidance has been instrumental in the organization's growth and sustainability.

boardMembers.name: Prof. Ngozi Okonkwo
boardMembers.title: Board Member - Education
boardMembers.bio: Professor of Education at University of Lagos, Dr. Okonkwo brings expertise in educational policy and youth development.

boardMembers.name: Alhaji Usman Ibrahim
boardMembers.title: Board Member - Finance
boardMembers.bio: Former Director at Central Bank of Nigeria, Alhaji Ibrahim provides financial oversight and strategic direction.

advisoryCouncil.name: Dr. James Wilson
advisoryCouncil.title: International Advisor
advisoryCouncil.bio: Dr. Wilson has over 20 years of experience in child welfare and international development.
